messages:
maria-ml: quick update — ran a smoke bring-up for llama-3-13b on weight-only int8 (bitsandbytes load_in_8bit + llm.int8 path) and saw a weird micro-regression on LAMBADA slices.

alex-research: can you paste the exact commands and the numbers?

maria-ml: sure. conversion/load used: ```python
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(path, load_in_8bit=True, device_map='auto')
```
perf/metrics: FP16 baseline (A100-p4): mem 52GB, infer latency 220ms @ 8 tok/sec, LAMBADA acc 72.1
bitsandbytes int8 (A100): mem 28GB, latency 205ms @ 9 tok/sec, LAMBADA acc 71.4 (-0.7)
llm.int8 (fast path on same hw): mem 30GB, latency 198ms @ 9.5 tok/sec, LAMBADA acc 71.9 (-0.2)

alex-research: interesting — quality delta small overall but slice-level variance? which slices regressed?

maria-ml: Sophie dug in: short-context creative prompts and some code-completion examples show ~1.5-2.0% drop for bnb int8. llm.int8 seems closer to FP16 except a couple of math QA examples.

sophie-evals: pasted per-slice table (summaries):
- common-sense-sentences: FP16 83.2, bnb8 82.9, llm8 83.1
- math-short: FP16 61.0, bnb8 58.9, llm8 60.4
- code-snippets: FP16 45.3, bnb8 43.1, llm8 44.8

maria-ml: also saw a reproducible token-level instability on a few examples where the next-token prob mass shifted — likely quantization scaling at certain layers.

tian-ops: from infra side: the memory drop is great for Dedicated packing. But note: KV-cache footprint behaves weirdly under bnb load_in_8bit on GPUs with <40GB. We saw occasional OOM on T4s when batch >4.

deploy-bot: deploy check — replica autoscale policy: can set fallback to FP16 model if p95 latency > 450ms for 2min. Would you like that enabled for the canary? :gear:

maria-ml: yes, enable fallback for canary. Also plan to run a per-layer sensitivity analysis (drop-in precision per layer) to find which blocks cause math/code regressions.

alex-research: hypothesis: attention projection/scaling layers are most sensitive. Two mitigations to try:
1) mixed precision: keep attention + output heads in FP16, quantize rest to 8-bit weight-only.
2) calibration table for per-channel scales (slow but could reduce outliers).

sophie-evals: will add a small eval slice targeting arithmetic and code, 1k queries, run across profiles: FP16, bnb8, llm8, and AWQ (gptq-like) for comparison. Scheduling for tonight.

maria-ml: quick perf note for deployment profiles: on A100-p4 we get ~9.5 tok/sec with llm.int8 and 12 tok/sec on A100-80GB with bnb+kv-cache tuning. On T4: FP16 often OOM, bnb int8 enables 1-2x throughput but watch latency jitter.

alex-research: action items:
- sophie-evals: run slice eval + post results in this thread (ETA 12h)
- maria-ml: run per-layer quant-sensitivity and a mixed-precision experiment (prioritize attn/outproj)
- tian-ops: enable canary fallback to FP16 and add T4 memwarn alerts

sophie-evals: posted quick job id: eval-202903-llama3-int8-01. I will upload CSVs to the eval bucket and ping when ready.

maria-ml: small debugging tip I used: to reproduce the next-token divergence, run the exact seed + single-example inference with torch.no_grad and compare logits pre-softmax between FP16 and quantized (look at topk differences). sample command: ```python
with torch.no_grad():
  out_fp = model_fp(input_ids)
  out_q = model_q(input_ids)
  diff = (out_fp.logits - out_q.logits).abs().max()
  print(diff)
```

alex-research: thanks. if per-layer points to feedforward dense layers we'll try keeping them FP16 first. if attention layers are the culprit maybe try small-block AWQ/GPTQ requant on attention.

deploy-bot: noted: canary fallback enabled, T4 memwarn rule created.

maria-ml: will post eval CSVs + a few failing examples for model team to inspect. thanks all. :rocket:
